figures.finding: No rule or permit for a child performer is named: the Code bars employing or engaging a child under fifteen to perform work in any capacity except light work, which children of thirteen or fourteen may do, and bars hazardous work; a 2025 regulation elaborates light and hazardous work (not read). So the general law reaches a child actor, writer or director (reading from the Ministry's summary; the Code's text wasn't read).
figures.applies: Employment and Industrial Relations Code 2015, as the Ministry summarises it.

sources.said: An employer shall not employ or engage a child under 15 years to perform work in any capacity, except in light work. Children aged 13 or 14 may be employed in light work and prohibited from hazardous work. ... A child labour Regulation adopted 2025, to elaborate more light work and harzadous work,
